title: Regularization can shrink a slope
hook: Two stated cases: explore the coefficient bias of a stipulated ridge fit.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the coefficient bias of a stipulated ridge fit affects the stated comparison

objective: Compare the coefficient bias of a stipulated ridge fit in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
